verdict.rationale: Fly.io describes a pay-as-you-go model where you pay only for the compute, storage, and bandwidth you use, and disk is billed per byte actually written. A community comment also mentions reviewing its published network pricing, which suggests a rate schedule exists. However, the pack contains no actual rates and no description of plan limits or overage thresholds. Missing for 10: concrete per-unit rates for bandwidth, compute and storage, any documented plan limits or overage schedule, build-minute or invocation pricing, and pre-billing cost visibility or alerts.
